slides.title: Any spend over *€200 waits *48 hours.
slides.body: One rule against impulse buys in your business.

slides.title: Write it *down first.
slides.body: What it is, what it costs per year, what it replaces.

slides.title: Wait *48 hours.
slides.body: Most 'urgent' tools stop feeling urgent by day two.

slides.title: Does it *make or save money?
slides.body: If neither, it's a want. Fine, but call it that.

slides.title: One in, *one out.
slides.body: A new subscription starts only when an old one is cancelled.

slides.title: Check subscriptions *monthly.
slides.body: Ten minutes with your bank statement. Cancel what you didn't use.

slides.title: Slow spending is *fast runway.
slides.body: Follow @operatorhabits for one habit a day.
